price_basis: Record daily decision-time adjusted input vintage without retroactive rewriting. Actual forward paper entry/exit uses archived published raw OHLCV, cross-source checks and unchanged raw levels. If a capital action or material vintage revision affects a position, freeze DATA_UNVERIFIABLE; never retrospectively adjust stops/targets or invent fills.
execution_evidence: Positive, finite, range-consistent raw OHLCV with positive volume, same calendar session and independent dated reference agreement within0.1%; current raw snapshot cannot claim a historical independent sequence. Without corroborated open log NOT_EXECUTABLE. Intraday path unknown: gap stop at raw open, target/stop same bar stop first; favorable target gap capped at target. Decisions precede next-session open. Integer shares; no borrowing.
signal_evidence: Audit all production Entry/Partial Entry even when not executable; shadow hypotheses require existing registered causal gates plus historical-window integrity. Record source validity and independent verification separately. No hypothetical prediction before registration is ever prospective.
event_model: Exclusive atomic create, canonical JSON SHA256 hash chain, stable semantic event ids across reruns, immutable snapshot objects, no mutation/deletion of existing durable paths; state/dashboard are derived projections. Same source rerun emits no second prediction/execution. Changed content under the same source identity is a separate DATA_REVISION and processing is blocked.
immutable_limit: Application-enforced append-only and independently checkable artifact/Git commit anchors; not WORM storage and not protection against an owner rewriting every external anchor or deleting the repository. No branch administration changes.
benchmark_policy: Benchmark returns require archived observed closes and adequate independent dated confirmation over the prospective interval; otherwise null. No forward-filled closes or independently-validated label from a matching current quote alone.
selection_and_bias: Current254 universe and current-sector leave-target-out proxy are disclosed, not PIT constituents. Revised adjusted historical data is never used to rewrite already recorded decisions or outcomes. No parameter optimization on forward outcomes.
alerts: Files only: newly confirmed production actionable events or material production-state changes; shadow hypotheses never labelled production Entry or sent as purchase alerts. Operational degradation is separate. Existing ChatGPT report integration remains unverified.
acceptance_pending: A genuinely new post-registration scheduled session and sufficient future outcomes cannot be manufactured on a weekend. Bootstrap/manual historical snapshots are AUDIT_ONLY and do not count toward prospective acceptance.
